speakerA.en: What time do you get up on weekdays?
That's early! What do you do first?
Do you go to work by car?

speakerB.en: I usually get up at six thirty.
I take a shower, then I have breakfast.
No, I take the bus. It leaves at seven forty.

scenarios.context: Two friends talk about their evenings.

speakerA.en: What do you do after work?
Do you ever go to the gym?
I never have time. I get home very late.

speakerB.en: I go home, cook dinner and relax.
Maybe you can try on the weekend.

scenarios.context: A nurse talks about her schedule.

speakerA.en: Your schedule is different from mine. When do you sleep?
What do you eat before work?

speakerB.en: I work at night, so I sleep in the morning.
A little, but I like the quiet hours.
Eggs and coffee, usually at eight in the evening.

speakerA.en: What do you do on Saturdays?
Do you go out in the evening?
Sounds nice. I usually stay at home and watch TV.

speakerB.en: I sleep late and clean the house.
Often. I meet my friends at a cafe.
You should come with us next time.

speakerA.en: What time did you finish work?

speakerB.en: It was busy. I had three meetings.
I finished at seven and went straight home.
No, I was too tired, so I ordered pizza.
